introduction: One morning, a man makes a surprising announcement to his wife. In an attempt to stop him from going through with his plan, his wife, and daughter, Saya, try to dissuade him, but the conversation takes an unexpected turn. Gradually, the man, who was born and raised in Japan as a “foreigner”, reveals his long-held jealousy and resentment toward them. Now, as the hidden sides of each family member are exposed, will the bonds they’ve built as husband and wife, parent and child, and as a family, be strong enough to keep them from falling apart? As complex emotions course through this bilingual family, what will become of them?
